guitar.notes: Leo Nocentelli is the celebrated funk guitarist of The Meters, influential to funk/New Orleans guitar styles; reasonably documented but no single universally iconic guitar.

tone.target: dry funky wah rhythm with tight mid bite
tone.profile: dry funky wah rhythm with tight mid bite
tone.summary: A tight, funky rhythm tone achieved using a light boost/OD, Wah filter for articulation, and a clean Fender-style amp model (US Deluxe) paired with a small cabinet to emphasize the dry, percussive nature of the music.
